name: Hydroxycarbamide (hydroxyurea)
contraindications: Pregnancy, severe bone marrow suppression, known hypersensitivity
interactions: Concurrent cytotoxic or marrow-suppressing drugs increase risk of myelosuppression; monitor co-administered agents
monitoring: Regular full blood counts, and renal and liver function tests; frequency depends on indication and dose
pregnancy: Contraindicated due to teratogenicity; effective contraception required for patients of childbearing potential
sideEffects: Myelosuppression, mucositis, gastrointestinal upset, potential teratogenicity
clinicalPearls: Specialist-led dosing and monitoring required; used in myeloproliferative disorders and to reduce vaso-occlusive crises in sickle cell disease
indication: Polycythaemia vera, essential thrombocythaemia, sickle cell disease and other specialist indications
